description: Readiness assessment for a future Strategy-to-Draft Configuration Builder. It does not create any storefront configuration.

decisions.explanation: Industry is a compiler context decision. The current theme has no global industry setting, so no automatic Theme Editor value is available.
Brand personality influences downstream typography, spacing, motion, and composition, but it is not represented by a standalone Shopify setting.
Visual language maps to existing scale, spacing, color-scheme, and composition controls, but it does not map to one atomic Theme Editor setting.
Scale, line-height, and tracking map directly; font selection remains merchant-review because a profile name is not a licensed font choice.
Spacing profiles map to the real global layout controls and their token-backed defaults.
The theme exposes scheme selection, while the actual palette definitions are merchant-owned color-scheme data rather than strategy-owned values.
The theme supports responsive media and explicit media fields, but photographic style cannot be automatically derived or manufactured by a Shopify setting.
The global motion controls and several section-level animation toggles exist; there is no universal per-section animation profile setting.
Conversion strategy maps to installed commerce, trust, and lead-capture sections, but urgency, claims, and proof require merchant-controlled content and verification.
Blueprints constrain the installed-section flow and maximum section count through existing page-blueprints and section capabilities.
Every current layout-recipe section is checked against an installed section capability profile.
The compiler’s selected sections are validated against installed section files and their generated capability profiles.
Ordering uses existing recipe, blueprint, composition-rule, compatibility, content-density, and installed-section data.
